units.canonical_text: See how directory sign-in leads to app access or a temporary AWS session. Active Directory Domain Services stores users, groups, and computers; Federation Services authenticates against it.
units.speech_text: See how directory sign-in leads to app access or a temporary AWS session. Active Directory Domain Services stores users, groups, and computers; Federation Services authenticates against it.

units.canonical_text: Federation Services issues a SAML assertion. The relying party uses it to recognize the signed-in user. This passes an assertion across the trust boundary, not a copied directory account.
units.speech_text: Federation Services issues a Sammel assertion. The relying party uses it to recognize the signed-in user. This passes an assertion across the trust boundary, not a copied directory account.

units.canonical_text: For AWS access, IAM checks the configured SAML provider and role trust. AWS STS exchanges a valid assertion for a temporary role session.
units.speech_text: For AWS access, IAM checks the configured Sammel provider and role trust. AWS S T S exchanges a valid assertion for a temporary role session.
